tips.text: Run Steel Path; it pays about 1.5 times the Heartstrings per rotation plus Steel Essence.
Extract at wave 12; a bugged failure or a Blitz Eximus one-shotting Flare wipes the whole run.
Farm Temple in the same runs; Heartstrings buy both and the mission also drops arcanes, relics and Endo.
Bring Nova or another strong AoE nuke frame to speed the waves.
Use damage reduction on Flare, not Vazarin healing; Vazarin only gives Flare 500 HP per 5 seconds.
Turn off dynamic lighting if the frame rate drops on this tileset.
Collect Hex standing trinkets from their fixed spawn spots; no treasure finder is needed.
Get the Entrati Lanthorn and Bellow Voca from Deimos or Zariman before the Heartstrings run out.
Players call the farm fun but buggy, with a full Temple and Riot-848 set in a few hours.
Most players build the Riot-848 for Mastery and move on; the gun itself is poorly rated.
